root_idea.summary: A root-level orientation toward gathering or aggregation, realized most clearly in فَوْجٌ, a gathered company or group.
root_idea.development: The central noun sense is a gathered body, with أَفْوَاجٌ denoting gathered companies or crowds. Other supplied entries preserve separate form-specific developments involving odor diffusion, cooling, haste, dispersal, camel-driving, and incitement; the rapid-movement form is explicitly distinguished as belonging to the yāʾ-root branch.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized singular dictionary citation form فَوْجٌ; the QAC group includes its singular and plural inflections.

senses.definition: A gathered company, troop, or crowd; a group moving or passing together.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a singular company and, in the plural أَفْوَاجًا, for crowds or multitudes. Quranic usage includes groups being admitted, cast, or entering together. The characterization of a group as passing swiftly is attested, but speed is not a necessary restriction on every occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diffuse or exhale an odor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in reference to musk and its odor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the day or sun, to become cool or moderated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the day, or to the sun at the cool time of day; this is marked as a figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cool or refresh oneself with cool air.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction describing refreshment by the coolness of the air.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten, go quickly, or run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV usage expressing rapid movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people or party, to go away and spread or disperse through the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV construction with a group as subject and dispersal through the land as the resulting movement.
A separately reported, opposite signification of the Form IV verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send camels to a watering place, driving them in successive groups.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV construction involving camels being driven drove by drove to a watering trough or tank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be urged or incited to become brisk, prompt, or quick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive Form X construction describing a person being stimulated to act with promptness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company consisting of the followers or dependants of a chief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social application of the company or group sense.
An apparently figurative extension beyond a company of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fat she-camel; also, as reported, one that is ḥāʾil and fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application to a she-camel, reported separately from the company sense.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The odor-diffusion meaning is represented as a Classical Arabic branch.
The cooling meaning of the day or sun is represented separately.

cautions: The rapid-movement meaning of أَفَاجَ is retained as a Lane-attested derived-form usage, but the root-level discussion explicitly assigns it to the yāʾ-root branch rather than treating it as a direct meaning of the Quranic noun.
The Quranic noun has a broad company or group sense. Density, speed, and particular social membership are contextual or specialized descriptions, not universal restrictions on every occurrence.
